Scene: Zero awakens alone in a rain-soaked ruined stone crypt. Camera very close to the stone coffin rim at a low oblique angle, foreground rain drops and chipped wet stone. A pale short silver-grey bob-haired girl wearing her torn white hooded cloak over a black dress with delicate gold seams has just pushed herself half upright; one gloved hand gripping the rim, shoulders tense, damp hair clinging to her cheek. Her one cyan and one warm amber eye stare with frightened confusion toward a thin shaft of cold rain-light; mouth barely parted, no smile. The empty space beside her is more disturbing than a monster. A small blue soul lantern on the floor illuminates the underside of her fingers. Depth: foreground massive coffin edge, her intimate upper-body portrait across the mid-left, shadowed arches receding on right. The image should feel like the instant she realizes she cannot remember anything, vulnerable and quietly terrifying. Her clothing stays intact; no injury or gore. Scene: inside an enormous upside-down clock tower, a held breath before the mechanism breaks. Jialan, preserve reference1's youthful androgynous puppet face, short lavender hair, violet eyes, small patch on cheek, fitted violet-black long coat with gold chains, large brass winding key behind head. He stands centre-right on a narrow broken clock hand above a bottomless violet-blue shaft, coat flaring sideways. Massive suspended brass gears fill upper third, one arrested pendulum cuts a diagonal, a narrow amber beam catches the spring and hands, violet lightning runs far in background without obscuring faces.
